I love Aliens. I love it to death. I even tried to play Colonial Marines, despite how awful it was, although I ended up refunding it because it was literally unplayable. This... Is playable, at least. The atmosphere is cool... The first five times. There's a huge arsenal that... you have to level up, and it takes hours. There's a good mix of classes... That also need to level up, and that takes hours. There's four awesome locations with three missions each... That take about thirty minutes to complete.  

I'm currently over 20 hours in, and I've leveled one class, and one gun to max. And they want you to level thirty guns to max for a single achievement. In a game with only twelve missions that last, at most, twenty minutes each once you get familiar with them. This wouldn't be a problem if the levels mixed themselves up or had a roguelite type of effect, but the randomization of the levels is basically limited to where your obligatory hidden loot crate will spawn, rather than actually sending you down any different corridors or areas. You don't even get different objectives. 

In terms of character interaction, they don't even move their lips when speaking although the dialogue is genuinely well written, and voiced. There's no cinematic of a cool explosion or an escaping dropship, or an alien queen plummeting into space at the end of any levels. There is only returning to the Endeavor, so you can do it all again. And again. And again... 
Even the final level rewards you with... Returning to the Endeavor, followed by unlocking a character class for you to level up. Again. 

Let me reiterate. I love Aliens. I really do. And there's a lot of cool lore here that spans the entire series, and that's really neat. But I don't know if it's worth it and I didn't even pay for this game. If you're a completionist and you want all the achievements, you are going to be REALLY sick of these twelve levels by the time you reach 100%. 
There is straight up not enough content here, even if you aren't going for all the achievements. It's not worth the price tag. Get it on a deep sale if you REALLY want that lore but even then I have trouble recommending it. 

Seriously, add more playable content, and not character skins that I can't customize with the insane amount of decals I have that only go on guns anyways and are literally impossible to see in game. I don't want more colors for my armat gun that's supposed to be military green. i don't want customization that costs half the price of far better indie games. And I DEFINITELY do not want another character class to suck up another twenty five hours of my life to level up. 

I want L E V E L S. I want S T O R Y. I want to fight more interesting alien types, or the Queen. And most of all, render a %&$*ing cinematic for when I BEAT THE GAME. Maybe at that point I could honestly be satisfied with this game, but until that point, even though I love Aliens, I sadly cannot recommend it. Full stop.
